panels.title: AI Model Status & Causal Decision Context

targets.query:
from(bucket: "factory_telemetry")
  |> range(start: -30m)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ai_part_risk" and r._field == "decision_time")
  |> group(columns: ["scenario_model"])
  |> last()
  |> keep(columns: ["scenario_model"])

from(bucket: "factory_telemetry")
  |> range(start: -1h)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ai_part_risk" and r._field == "predicted_defect_prob")
  |> count()

options.content:
### Zero Leakage & Strict Hold-out
- **Decision Time:** Evaluated strictly at S35/S36 entry before reaching S37.
- **Scenario Isolation:** Model trained without scenario window (+/- 3.0 margin units).
- **Causal Defect Rate:** Historical feedback restricted to parts completed <= decision time.

panels.title: Part-Level Defect Risk Prediction (PyTorch MLP + Platt Calibration)
Predicted Defect Probability vs Actual Historical Prevalence

targets.query:
from(bucket: "factory_telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ai_part_risk" and r._field == "predicted_defect_prob")
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 10s, fn: mean, createEmpty: false)
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "Predicted Risk (P)")

from(bucket: "factory_telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "line_overview" and r._field == "cumulative_defect_rate")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({ r with _value: r._value / 100.0 }))
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "Line Observed Defect Rate")

from(bucket: "factory_telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ai_part_risk" and r._field == "predicted_defect_prob" and r.is_high_risk == "True")
  |> group(columns: ["station_id"])

panels.title: Line & Station Multivariate Anomaly Detection (LSTM Autoencoder)
Reconstruction Anomaly Score vs Calibrated Threshold (p99)

targets.query:
from(bucket: "factory_telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ai_anomaly" and r._field == "anomaly_score")
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "Reconstruction Error (MSE)")

from(bucket: "factory_telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ai_anomaly" and r._field == "threshold_p99")
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "Threshold (p99 Normal Windows)")

from(bucket: "factory_telemetry")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ai_anomaly" and (r._field == "attr_S29" or r._field == "attr_S30" or r._field == "attr_S33" or r._field == "attr_S34" or r._field == "attr_S35" or r._field == "attr_S36" or r._field == "attr_S37"))
  |> last()
